full.quality_rule: FULL keeps the existing high bar: explain a concrete technical/workflow change, production or pipeline consequence, and an actionable adoption test, risk, limitation, or maturity judgment.

brief.quality_rule: BRIEF is allowed only when the intelligence is verified, unpublished, relevant and concretely useful, but available source evidence cannot honestly support FULL depth. State the known fact/value and explicitly mark what remains unverified or immature. BRIEF must never be used to admit marketing-only, unverifiable, duplicate or negligible-value content.

top5_policy.rule: Homepage TOP5 requires FULL analysis. BRIEF may appear in category/daily intelligence but cannot displace a FULL item in TOP5.

quality_rule: Quality Gate and analysis-depth classification are separate. First decide whether an item is verified, unpublished and worth knowing; then classify it FULL or BRIEF based on source evidence depth. Never fabricate or pad evidence to upgrade BRIEF to FULL.
legacy_policy: Dates before tiered_effective_date keep the prior FULL-only depth behavior and are not retroactively reclassified.
